svg.title: Six latitudinal macrozones and an illustrative categorical output
svg.desc: The six macrozones are reconstructed from Table 2 of Nicolis, Plaza and Salas, 2021, with Natural Earth geographic context. A constructed maximum in zone three and a six-class probability vector illustrate the classification task, not empirical predictions.
svg.text: Constructed example: next-map maximum is in zone 3
One target class · probabilities sum to 1
Marker and probabilities are illustrative, not model predictions.
